spec.query:
from(bucket: "Mimid_PnLStatsTest")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "exch_daily_pnl")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pnl")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "Mimid_PnLStatsTest")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "exch_daily_trade_vol")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "trade_vol")  
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()  
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field"])
  |> sum()
